visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit indoor gym with light-colored wooden floors. A young woman with dark hair in a ponytail, wearing an olive-colored sports bra and high-waisted shorts, performs tricep cable pushdowns. She grips the rope handle firmly, her facial expression concentrated as she pulls the weight down, focusing on her arm muscles. In the background, various red and black strength training machines are visible along with distant blurry figures. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting on a large grey exercise ball in a different area of the gym. Behind her is a wall featuring a promotional poster with Chinese text and the brand name 'VERVE'. She bounces slightly on the ball, appearing winded or resting between her sets, looking down at the floor with a neutral, focused expression while adjusting her position. (3) Next, she is shown using a seated hip abduction machine. A small cat sticker is overlaid on the frame covering her crotch area. As she pushes the machine pads outward with her legs, she appears momentarily surprised by the resistance or the movement, quickly covering her mouth with her right hand and laughing at the camera. (4) The montage continues with her using an elliptical trainer or stationary bike with handles. She grips the moving vertical handles, her body swaying in a rhythmic cardio motion. The lighting remains bright and even across the gym floor, reflecting off the mirrors and polished surfaces of the exercise equipment. (5) In the final segment, she is positioned on a back extension machine. She bends her upper body forward and then raises it back up, demonstrating controlled muscle movement. She then reaches down toward the metallic base of the machine to adjust a setting before the clip concludes.
